> \"$STATUS_FILE\" ) 2>&1 | tee -a \"$LOG_FILE\"\nstatus=$(cat \"$STATUS_FILE\")\nrm -f \"$STATUS_FILE\"\n\necho \"=== test finished at $(date '+%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S') with exit $status ===\" | tee -a \"$LOG_FILE\"\nexit \"$status\"\ncli:\n__init__.py\n__pycache__\ncommands\nregistry.py\ntesting.py\n\ncli/commands:\n__init__.py\n__pycache__\n\"\"\"Command-line entry point for the ledger.\n\n``main`` resolves the command words, checks the argument count, opens the database, calls the\nhandler, and turns the result into CSV on stdout or one diagnostic line on stderr. It returns the\nexit code and never calls ``sys.exit``; the ``ledger`` launcher is the only caller that does.\n\"\"\"\n\nimport sys\nfrom pathlib import Path\n\nfrom cli import registry\nfrom ledger_core.config import database_path\nfrom ledger_core.errors import LedgerError, Operational\nfrom persistence import Database, open_database\n\nEXIT_OK = 0\nEXIT_OPERATIONAL = 1\nEXIT_USAGE = 2\nPOSTGRES_PREFIXES = (\"postgres://\", \"postgresql://\")\n\n\ndef _usage_error(message: str) -> int:\n    print(f\"usage: {message}\", file=sys.stderr)\n    return EXIT_USAGE\n\n\ndef _open_store(location: str) -> Database:\n    \"\"\"Open the declared store. A SQLite file whose directory is absent is refused, not created.\n\n    The shipped SQLite driver creates a missing parent directory on connect, which would turn a\n    mistyped location into a new, empty store. The ledger's store is provisioned in advance.\n    \"\"\"\n    if not location.startswith(POSTGRES_PREFIXES):\n        parent = Path(location).parent\n        if not parent.is_dir():\n            raise Operational(f\"database directory does not exist: {parent}\")\n    return open_database(location)\n\n\ndef _match(argv: list[str]) -> tuple[tuple[str, ...], registry.Command] | None:\n    \"\"\"Return the longest command-word prefix of ``argv`` that is registered, with its command.\"\"\"\n    for length in range(len(argv), 0, -1):\n        words = tuple(argv[:length])\n        if words in registry.COMMANDS:\n            return words, registry.COMMANDS[words]\n    return None\n\n\ndef _format(rows: list[list[str]]) -> str:\n    \"\"\"Render rows as unquoted CSV with ``\\\\n`` line endings.\"\"\"\n    return \"\".join(\",\".join(str(value) for value in row) + \"\\n\" for row in rows)\n\n\ndef main(argv: list[str] | None = None) -> int:\n    argv = sys.argv[1:] if argv is None else list(argv)\n    registry.load()\n\n    matched = _match(argv)\n    if matched is None:\n        return _usage_error(f\"unknown command {' '.join(argv)!r}\" if argv else \"no command given\")\n    words, command = matched\n\n    args = argv[len(words):]\n    if len(args) < command.min_args or (command.max_args is not None and len(args) > command.max_args):\n        return _usage_error(f\"wrong number of arguments for {' '.join(words)!r}\")\n\n    try:\n        database = _open_store(database_path())\n    except Exception as exc:\n        print(f\"error: cannot open database: {exc}\", file=sys.stderr)\n        return EXIT_OPERATIONAL\n\n    try:\n        rows = command.handler(database, args)\n    except LedgerError as exc:\n        print(f\"error: {exc}\", file=sys.stderr)\n        return exc.exit_code\n    except Exception as exc:\n        print(f\"error: {exc}\", file=sys.stderr)\n        return EXIT_OPERATIONAL\n    finally:\n        database.close()\n\n    sys.stdout.write(_format(rows))\n    return EXIT_OK\n\"\"\"Command registry: maps command words to handlers, filled from the modules in ``cli/commands/``.\"\"\"\n\nimport importlib\nimport pkgutil\nfrom collections.abc import Callable\nfrom typing import Any, NamedTuple\n\nfrom cli import commands\n\n\nclass Command(NamedTuple):\n    \"\"\"One registered command. ``max_args`` is ``None`` when the argument count is unbounded.\"\"\"\n\n    handler: Callable[[Any, list[str]], list[list[str]]]\n    min_args: int\n    max_args: int | None\n\n\n#: Command words, such as ``(\"account\", \"add\")``, mapped to their command.\nCOMMANDS: dict[tuple[str, ...], Command] = {}\n\n\ndef load() -> None:\n    \"\"\"Import every module in ``cli/commands/`` and add its ``COMMANDS``. Idempotent; never removes.\"\"\"\n    for module_info in pkgutil.iter_modules(commands.__path__):\n        module = importlib.import_module(f\"{commands.__name__}.{module_info.name}\")\n        COMMANDS.update(getattr(module, \"COMMANDS\", {}))\n__pycache__\ntest_cli.py\ntest_config.py\ntest_errors.py\ntest_foundation.py\n\"\"\"Domain error classes and their exit codes.\"\"\"\n\nimport pytest\n\nfrom ledger_core.errors import LedgerError, NotFound, Operational, Rejected\n\n\n@pytest.mark.parametrize(\n    (\"cls\", \"code\"),\n    [(Rejected, 3), (NotFound, 4), (Operational, 1)],\n)\ndef test_error_class_carries_exit_code(cls, code):\n    assert cls(\"probe\").exit_code == code\n\n\n@pytest.mark.parametrize(\"cls\", [Rejected, NotFound, Operational])\ndef test_error_class_derives_from_ledger_error(cls):\n    assert issubclass(cls, LedgerError)\n\n\ndef test_error_keeps_its_message():\n    assert str(Rejected(\"duplicate account\")) == \"duplicate account\"","is_error":false}]},"parent_tool_use_id":null,"session_id":"6e31620d-a49d-4cfb-89b1-216573851304","uuid":"aacf0462-5de2-433e-8823-5f0e9780c878","timestamp":"2026-10-27T14:26:38.730Z","tool_use_result":{"stdout":"\"\"\"Domain errors. number of arguments for {' '.join(words)!r}\")\n\n    try:\n        database = _open_store(database_path())\n    except Exception as exc:\n        print(f\"error: cannot open database: {exc}\", sys.stdout.write(_format(rows))\n    return EXIT_OK\n\"\"\"Command registry: maps command words to handlers, filled from the modules in ``cli/commands/``.\"\"\"\n\nimport importlib\nimport Nothing here touches\nstorage or prints anything.\n\"\"\"\n\nimport datetime\nimport re\n\nfrom ledger_core.errors import Rejected\n\nCODE_MAX = 12\nNAME_MAX = 40\nMEMO_MAX = 60\n\n_CODE = re.compile(r\"[A-Z0-9]{1,%d}\" % CODE_MAX)\n_DATE = re.compile(r\"([0-9]{4})-([0-9]{2})-([0-9]{2})\")\n_FORBIDDEN_TEXT = (\",\", \"\\n\", \"\\r\")\n\n\ndef _require_text(value: object, label: str) -> str:\n    if not isinstance(value, str):\n        raise Rejected(f\"{label} must be text\")\n    return value\n\n\ndef _check_length(value: str, label: str, low: int, high: int) -> None:\n    if not low <= len(value) <= high:\n        raise Rejected(f\"{label} must be {low} to {high} characters\")\n\n\ndef _check_plain_text(value: str, label: str) -> None:\n    if any(mark in value for mark in _FORBIDDEN_TEXT):\n        raise Rejected(f\"{label} must not contain a comma or newline\")\n\n\ndef validate_code(value: str) -> str:\n    \"\"\"Accept 1 to 12 characters, each ``A-Z`` or ``0-9``.\"\"\"\n    text = _require_text(value, \"code\")\n    if not _CODE.fullmatch(text):\n        raise Rejected(\"code must be 1 to 12 characters from A-Z and 0-9\")\n    return value\n\n\ndef validate_name(value: str) -> str:\n    \"\"\"Accept 1 to 40 characters with no comma or newline.\"\"\"\n    text = _require_text(value, \"name\")\n    _check_length(text, \"name\", 1, NAME_MAX)\n    _check_plain_text(text, \"name\")\n    return value\n\n\ndef validate_memo(value: str) -> str:\n    \"\"\"Accept 0 to 60 characters with no comma or newline.\"\"\"\n    text = _require_text(value, \"memo\")\n    _check_length(text, \"memo\", 0, MEMO_MAX)\n    _check_plain_text(text, \"memo\")\n    return value\n\n\ndef validate_date(value: str) -> str:\n    \"\"\"Accept a real calendar date written ``YYYY-MM-DD``.\"\"\"\n    text = _require_text(value, \"date\")\n    match = _DATE.fullmatch(text)\n    if match is None:\n        raise Rejected(\"date must be written YYYY-MM-DD\")\n    year, month, day = (int(part) for part in match.groups())\n    try:\n        datetime.date(year, month, day)\n    except ValueError as exc:\n        raise Rejected(f\"date is not a real calendar date: {text}\") from exc\n    return {"type":"assistant","message":{"model":"claude-haiku-5-5","id":"msg_011CgSu2Us5LrMrCB51fQtJg","type":"message","role":"assistant","content":[{"type":"tool_use","id":"toolu_01DfigXEETNy9LnusgiPRx9q","name":"Write","input":{"file_path":"/mnt/c/Users/barlo/projects/drydock/uat/LayersTesting/runs/20261027.135355/build/LayersTesting/ledger_core/money.py","content":"\"\"\"Conversion between amount text and integer cents.\n\nAmounts are signed integer cents everywhere. Parsing and formatting use integer arithmetic only.\n\"\"\"\n\nimport re\n\nfrom ledger_core.errors import Rejected\n\n_AMOUNT = re.compile(r\"(-?)([0-9]+)(?:\\.([0-9]{1,2}))?\")\n\n\ndef parse_amount(text: str) -> int:\n    \"\"\"Parse ``-?DIGITS[.D[D]]`` into integer cents. Zero and three or more decimals are rejected.\"\"\"\n    if not isinstance(text, str):\n        raise Rejected(\"amount must be text\")\n    match = _AMOUNT.fullmatch(text)\n    if match is None:\n        raise Rejected(f\"amount must look like -12.50 with at most two decimals: {text!r}\")\n    sign, whole, fraction = match.groups()\n    cents = int(whole) * 100 + int((fraction or \"\").ljust(2, \"0\") or \"0\")\n    if cents == 0:\n        raise Rejected(\"amount must not be zero\")\n    return -cents if sign else cents\n\n\ndef format_cents(cents: int) -> str:\n    \"\"\"Render integer cents with exactly two decimals, a leading ``-`` when negative, no separators.\"\"\"\n    if not isinstance(cents, int) or isinstance(cents, bool):\n        raise Rejected(\"cents must be an integer\")\n    sign = \"-\" if cents < 0 else \"\"\n    magnitude = abs(cents)\n    return f\"{sign}{magnitude // 100}.{magnitude % 100:02d}\"\n"},"caller":{"type":"direct"}}],"container":null,"stop_reason":null,"stop_sequence":null,"stop_details":null,"usage":{"input_tokens":2,"cache_creation_input_tokens":1263,"cache_read_input_tokens":39715,"cache_creation":{"ephemeral_5m_input_tokens":0,"ephemeral_1h_input_tokens":1263},"output_tokens":8,"service_tier":"standard","inference_geo":"global","speed":"standard"},"input_transformations":[],"diagnostics":null,"context_management":null},"parent_tool_use_id":null,"session_id":"6e31620d-a49d-4cfb-89b1-216573851304","uuid":"231d37ad-d37e-4f9a-acb4-92bf3c34175d","timestamp":"2026-10-27T14:27:05.369Z","request_id":"req_011CgSu2UWVp86NF3dGKVddP","wire_tool_inputs":{"toolu_01DfigXEETNy9LnusgiPRx9q":{"file_path":"/mnt/c/Users/barlo/projects/drydock/uat/LayersTesting/runs/20261027.135355/build/LayersTesting/ledger_core/money.py","content":"\"\"\"Conversion between amount text and integer cents.\n\nAmounts are signed integer cents everywhere. Parsing and formatting use integer arithmetic only.\n\"\"\"\n\nimport re\n\nfrom ledger_core.errors import Rejected\n\n_AMOUNT = re.compile(r\"(-?)([0-9]+)(?:\\.([0-9]{1,2}))?\")\n\n\ndef parse_amount(text: str) -> int:\n    \"\"\"Parse ``-?DIGITS[.D[D]]`` into integer cents. Zero and three or more decimals are rejected.\"\"\"\n    if not isinstance(text, str):\n        raise Rejected(\"amount must be text\")\n    match = _AMOUNT.fullmatch(text)\n    if match is None:\n        raise Rejected(f\"amount must look like -12.50 with at most two decimals: {text!r}\")\n    sign, whole, fraction = match.groups()\n    cents = int(whole) * 100 + int((fraction or \"\").ljust(2, \"0\") or \"0\")\n    if cents == 0:\n        raise Rejected(\"amount must not be zero\")\n    return -cents if sign else cents\n\n\ndef format_cents(cents: int) -> str:\n    \"\"\"Render integer cents with exactly two decimals, a leading ``-`` when negative, no separators.\"\"\"\n    if not isinstance(cents, int) or isinstance(cents, bool):\n        raise Rejected(\"cents must be an integer\")\n    sign = \"-\" if cents < 0 else \"\"\n    magnitude = abs(cents)\n    return f\"{sign}{magnitude // 100}.{magnitude % 100:02d}\"\n"}}}

Parsing and formatting use integer arithmetic only.\n\"\"\"\n\nimport re\n\nfrom ledger_core.errors import Rejected\n\n_AMOUNT = re.compile(r\"(-?)([0-9]+)(?:\\.([0-9]{1,2}))?\")\n\n\ndef parse_amount(text: str) -> int:\n    \"\"\"Parse ``-?DIGITS[.D[D]]`` into integer cents. Zero and three or more decimals are rejected.\"\"\"\n    if not isinstance(text, str):\n        raise Rejected(\"amount must be text\")\n    match = _AMOUNT.fullmatch(text)\n    if match is None:\n        raise Rejected(f\"amount must look like -12.50 with at most two decimals: {text!r}\")\n    sign, whole, fraction = match.groups()\n    cents = int(whole) * 100 + int((fraction or \"\").ljust(2, \"0\") or \"0\")\n    if cents == 0:\n        raise Rejected(\"amount must not be zero\")\n    return -cents if sign else cents\n\n\ndef format_cents(cents: int) -> str:\n    \"\"\"Render integer cents with exactly two decimals, a leading ``-`` when negative, no separators.\"\"\"\n    if not isinstance(cents, int) or isinstance(cents, bool):\n        raise Rejected(\"cents must be an integer\")\n    sign = \"-\" if cents < 0 else \"\"\n    magnitude = abs(cents)\n    return f\"{sign}{magnitude // 100}.{magnitude % 100:02d}\"\n","structuredPatch":[{"oldStart":18,"oldLines":7,"newStart":18,"newLines":7,"lines":["     if match is None:","         raise Rejected(f\"amount must look like -12.50 with at most two decimals: {text!r}\")","     sign, whole, fraction = match.groups()","-    cents = int(whole) * 100 + int((fraction or \"\").ljust(2, \"0\") or \"0\")","+    cents = int(whole) * 100 + int((fraction or \"\").ljust(2, \"0\"))","     if cents == 0:","         raise Rejected(\"amount must not be zero\")","     return -cents if sign else cents"]}],"userModified":false,"replaceAll":false},"tool_result_meta":[{"id":"toolu_017QS8kfYXrjTVEDpgapbzkV","permission_decision":{"decision":"accept","source":"config","reason_type":"mode"}}]}

{"type":"assistant","message":{"model":"claude-haiku-5-5","id":"msg_011CgSu2uGmh4KiMJmy5A5TR","type":"message","role":"assistant","content":[{"type":"tool_use","id":"toolu_01JWPakkTvM5LJgXTwWtgUMh","name":"Write","input":{"file_path":"/mnt/c/Users/barlo/projects/drydock/uat/LayersTesting/runs/20261027.135355/build/LayersTesting/ledger_core/balances.py","content":"\"\"\"Balance rule: a proposed set of transaction changes must leave no account below zero.\n\nAn account's balance is the sum of its stored transaction amounts in integer cents. The check only\nreads through the persistence interface and never writes.\n\"\"\"\n\nfrom dataclasses import dataclass\nfrom typing import Union\n\nfrom ledger_core.errors import NotFound, Rejected\nfrom persistence import Database\n\n\n@dataclass(frozen=True)\nclass Insert:\n    \"\"\"A transaction to be added to ``account`` with ``amount`` cents.\"\"\"\n\n    account: str\n    amount: int\n\n\n@dataclass(frozen=True)\nclass Edit:\n    \"\"\"A stored transaction whose amount becomes ``amount`` cents.\"\"\"\n\n    txn_id: int\n    amount: int\n\n\n@dataclass(frozen=True)\nclass Delete:\n    \"\"\"A stored transaction to be removed.\"\"\"\n\n    txn_id: int\n\n\nChange = Union[Insert, Edit, Delete]\n\n\ndef current_balance(db: Database, account: str) -> int:\n    \"\"\"Return the sum of the stored amounts of ``account``; ``0`` when it has none.\"\"\"\n    return sum(row.amount for row in db.transactions.list(account=account))\n\n\ndef _stored(db: Database, txn_id: int):\n    stored = db.transactions.get(txn_id=txn_id)\n    if stored is None:\n        raise NotFound(f\"transaction {txn_id} does not exist\")\n    return stored\n\n\ndef _net_deltas(db: Database, changes: list[Change]) -> dict[str, int]:\n    \"\"\"Group the changes by account and sum each account's net effect in cents.\"\"\"\n    deltas: dict[str, int] = {}\n    for change in changes:\n        if isinstance(change, Insert):\n            account, delta = change.account, change.amount\n        elif isinstance(change, Edit):\n            stored = _stored(db, change.txn_id)\n            account, delta = stored.account, change.amount - stored.amount\n        elif isinstance(change, Delete):\n            stored = _stored(db, change.txn_id)\n            account, delta = stored.account, -stored.amount\n        else:\n            raise Rejected(f\"unknown transaction change: {change!r}\")\n        deltas[account] = deltas.get(account, 0) + delta\n    return deltas\n\n\ndef check_no_negative(db: Database, changes: list[Change]) -> None:\n    \"\"\"Raise ``Rejected`` when any affected account's resulting balance is below zero.\n\n    Changes are judged together by their net effect per account, so their order does not matter.\n    A resulting balance of exactly zero is allowed. Accounts the changes do not touch are not judged.\n    \"\"\"\n    for account, delta in _net_deltas(db, list(changes)).items():\n        resulting = current_balance(db, account) + delta\n        if resulting < 0:\n            raise Rejected(f\"account {account} would be overdrawn by {-resulting} cents\")\n"},"caller":{"type":"direct"}}],"container":null,"stop_reason":null,"stop_sequence":null,"stop_details":null,"usage":{"input_tokens":2,"cache_creation_input_tokens":494,"cache_read_input_tokens":41810,"cache_creation":{"ephemeral_5m_input_tokens":0,"ephemeral_1h_input_tokens":494},"output_tokens":3,"service_tier":"standard","inference_geo":"global","speed":"standard"},"input_transformations":[],"diagnostics":null,"context_management":null},"parent_tool_use_id":null,"session_id":"6e31620d-a49d-4cfb-89b1-216573851304","uuid":"0a44d4e7-11c0-4849-aeaf-2ef41e9a2e38","timestamp":"2026-10-27T14:27:16.545Z","request_id":"req_011CgSu2tvg2B34haz111mtQ","wire_tool_inputs":{"toolu_01JWPakkTvM5LJgXTwWtgUMh":{"file_path":"/mnt/c/Users/barlo/projects/drydock/uat/LayersTesting/runs/20261027.135355/build/LayersTesting/ledger_core/balances.py","content":"\"\"\"Balance rule: a proposed set of transaction changes must leave no account below zero.\n\nAn account's balance is the sum of its stored transaction amounts in integer cents. The check only\nreads through the persistence interface and never writes.\n\"\"\"\n\nfrom dataclasses import dataclass\nfrom typing import Union\n\nfrom ledger_core.errors import NotFound, Rejected\nfrom persistence import Database\n\n\n@dataclass(frozen=True)\nclass Insert:\n    \"\"\"A transaction to be added to ``account`` with ``amount`` cents.\"\"\"\n\n    account: str\n    amount: int\n\n\n@dataclass(frozen=True)\nclass Edit:\n    \"\"\"A stored transaction whose amount becomes ``amount`` cents.\"\"\"\n\n    txn_id: int\n    amount: int\n\n\n@dataclass(frozen=True)\nclass Delete:\n    \"\"\"A stored transaction to be removed.\"\"\"\n\n    txn_id: int\n\n\nChange = Union[Insert, Edit, Delete]\n\n\ndef current_balance(db: Database, account: str) -> int:\n    \"\"\"Return the sum of the stored amounts of ``account``; ``0`` when it has none.\"\"\"\n    return sum(row.amount for row in db.transactions.list(account=account))\n\n\ndef _stored(db: Database, txn_id: int):\n    stored = db.transactions.get(txn_id=txn_id)\n    if stored is None:\n        raise NotFound(f\"transaction {txn_id} does not exist\")\n    return stored\n\n\ndef _net_deltas(db: Database, changes: list[Change]) -> dict[str, int]:\n    \"\"\"Group the changes by account and sum each account's net effect in cents.\"\"\"\n    deltas: dict[str, int] = {}\n    for change in changes:\n        if isinstance(change, Insert):\n            account, delta = change.account, change.amount\n        elif isinstance(change, Edit):\n            stored = _stored(db, change.txn_id)\n            account, delta = stored.account, change.amount - stored.amount\n        elif isinstance(change, Delete):\n            stored = _stored(db, change.txn_id)\n            account, delta = stored.account, -stored.amount\n        else:\n            raise Rejected(f\"unknown transaction change: {change!r}\")\n        deltas[account] = deltas.get(account, 0) + delta\n    return deltas\n\n\ndef check_no_negative(db: Database, changes: list[Change]) -> None:\n    \"\"\"Raise ``Rejected`` when any affected account's resulting balance is below zero.\n\n    Changes are judged together by their net effect per account, so their order does not matter.\n    A resulting balance of exactly zero is allowed. Accounts the changes do not touch are not judged.\n    \"\"\"\n    for account, delta in _net_deltas(db, list(changes)).items():\n        resulting = current_balance(db, account) + delta\n        if resulting < 0:\n            raise Rejected(f\"account {account} would be overdrawn by {-resulting} cents\")\n"}}}

{"type":"user","message":{"role":"user","content":[{"tool_use_id":"toolu_01JWPakkTvM5LJgXTwWtgUMh","type":"tool_result","content":"File created successfully at: /mnt/c/Users/barlo/projects/drydock/uat/LayersTesting/runs/20261027.135355/build/LayersTesting/ledger_core/balances.py (file state is current in your context — no need to Read it back)"}]},"parent_tool_use_id":null,"session_id":"6e31620d-a49d-4cfb-89b1-216573851304","uuid":"7e0d9a4c-df6d-483b-b7bc-868888699bb6","timestamp":"2026-10-27T14:27:16.585Z","tool_use_result":{"type":"create","filePath":"/mnt/c/Users/barlo/projects/drydock/uat/LayersTesting/runs/20261027.135355/build/LayersTesting/ledger_core/balances.py","content":"\"\"\"Balance rule: a proposed set of transaction changes must leave no account below zero.\n\nAn account's balance is the sum of its stored transaction amounts in integer cents. The check only\nreads through the persistence interface and never writes.\n\"\"\"\n\nfrom dataclasses import dataclass\nfrom typing import Union\n\nfrom ledger_core.errors import NotFound, Rejected\nfrom persistence import Database\n\n\n@dataclass(frozen=True)\nclass Insert:\n    \"\"\"A transaction to be added to ``account`` with ``amount`` cents.\"\"\"\n\n    account: str\n    amount: int\n\n\n@dataclass(frozen=True)\nclass Edit:\n    \"\"\"A stored transaction whose amount becomes ``amount`` cents.\"\"\"\n\n    txn_id: int\n    amount: int\n\n\n@dataclass(frozen=True)\nclass Delete:\n    \"\"\"A stored transaction to be removed.\"\"\"\n\n    txn_id: int\n\n\nChange = Union[Insert, Edit, Delete]\n\n\ndef current_balance(db: Database, account: str) -> int:\n    \"\"\"Return the sum of the stored amounts of ``account``; ``0`` when it has none.\"\"\"\n    return sum(row.amount for row in db.transactions.list(account=account))\n\n\ndef _stored(db: Database, txn_id: int):\n    stored = db.transactions.get(txn_id=txn_id)\n    if stored is None:\n        raise NotFound(f\"transaction {txn_id} does not exist\")\n    return stored\n\n\ndef _net_deltas(db: Database, changes: list[Change]) -> dict[str, int]:\n    \"\"\"Group the changes by account and sum each account's net effect in cents.\"\"\"\n    deltas: dict[str, int] = {}\n    for change in changes:\n        if isinstance(change, Insert):\n            account, delta = change.account, change.amount\n        elif isinstance(change, Edit):\n            stored = _stored(db, change.txn_id)\n            account, delta = stored.account, change.amount - stored.amount\n        elif isinstance(change, Delete):\n            stored = _stored(db, change.txn_id)\n            account, delta = stored.account, -stored.amount\n        else:\n            raise Rejected(f\"unknown transaction change: {change!r}\")\n        deltas[account] = deltas.get(account, 0) + delta\n    return deltas\n\n\ndef check_no_negative(db: Database, changes: list[Change]) -> None:\n    \"\"\"Raise ``Rejected`` when any affected account's resulting balance is below zero.\n\n    Changes are judged together by their net effect per account, so their order does not matter.\n    A resulting balance of exactly zero is allowed. Accounts the changes do not touch are not judged.\n    \"\"\"\n    for account, delta in _net_deltas(db, list(changes)).items():\n        resulting = current_balance(db, account) + delta\n        if resulting < 0:\n            raise Rejected(f\"account {account} would be overdrawn by {-resulting} cents\")\n","structuredPatch":[],"originalFile":null,"userModified":false},"tool_result_meta":[{"id":"toolu_01JWPakkTvM5LJgXTwWtgUMh","permission_decision":{"decision":"accept","source":"config","reason_type":"mode"}}]}

rule: changes are judged by net effect per account, and a check never writes.\"\"\"\n\nimport pytest\n\nfrom ledger_core.balances import Delete, Edit, Insert, check_no_negative, current_balance\nfrom ledger_core.errors import NotFound, Rejected\nfrom persistence.testing import db_session\n\nCATEGORY = \"ZZBRCAT\"\n\n\ndef _seed(db, account, amounts, first_txn_id):\n    db.accounts.create(account=account, name=\"Balance Test\")\n    db.categories.create(category=CATEGORY, description=\"Balance Cat\")\n    for offset, cents in enumerate(amounts):\n        db.transactions.create(txn_id=first_txn_id + offset, date=\"2026-05-01\", account=account,\n                               category=CATEGORY, amount=cents, memo=\"\")\n\n\ndef _count(db, *accounts):\n    return sum(len(db.transactions.list(account=account)) for account in accounts)\n\n\ndef test_current_balance_sums_stored_amounts():\n    with db_session() as db:\n        _seed(db, \"ZZBRA\", [1000, -300, -50], 910000001)\n        assert current_balance(db, \"ZZBRA\") == 650\n\n\ndef test_current_balance_is_zero_for_account_without_transactions():\n    with db_session() as db:\n        db.accounts.create(account=\"ZZBRE\", name=\"Empty Test\")\n        assert current_balance(db, \"ZZBRE\") == 0\n\n\ndef test_insert_landing_on_zero_is_allowed():\n    with db_session() as db:\n        _seed(db, \"ZZBRB\", [700], 910000011)\n        assert check_no_negative(db, [Insert(\"ZZBRB\", -700)]) is None\n\n\ndef test_insert_one_cent_below_zero_is_rejected_and_writes_nothing():\n    with db_session() as db:\n        _seed(db, \"ZZBRC\", [700], 910000021)\n        before = _count(db, \"ZZBRC\")\n        with pytest.raises(Rejected) as info:\n            check_no_negative(db, [Insert(\"ZZBRC\", -701)])\n        assert info.value.exit_code == 3\n        assert _count(db, \"ZZBRC\") == before\n\n\ndef test_insert_into_new_account_accepts_positive_and_rejects_negative():\n    with db_session() as db:\n        db.accounts.create(account=\"ZZBRD\", name=\"Fresh Test\")\n        assert check_no_negative(db, [Insert(\"ZZBRD\", 500)]) is None\n        with pytest.raises(Rejected):\n            check_no_negative(db, [Insert(\"ZZBRD\", -1)])\n\n\ndef test_edit_below_what_debits_need_is_rejected_and_stored_amount_unchanged():\n    with db_session() as db:\n        _seed(db, \"ZZBRE2\", [1000, -300], 910000031)\n        assert check_no_negative(db, [Edit(910000031, 300)]) is None\n        with pytest.raises(Rejected) as info:\n            check_no_negative(db, [Edit(910000031, 299)])\n        assert info.value.exit_code == 3\n        assert db.transactions.get(txn_id=910000031).amount == 1000\n\n\ndef test_delete_of_funding_credit_is_rejected_and_credit_remains():\n    with db_session() as db:\n        _seed(db, \"ZZBRF\", [1000, -300], 910000041)\n        assert check_no_negative(db, [Delete(910000042)]) is None\n        with pytest.raises(Rejected) as info:\n            check_no_negative(db, [Delete(910000041)])\n        assert info.value.exit_code == 3\n        assert db.transactions.get(txn_id=910000041) is not None\n\n\ndef test_edit_or_delete_of_missing_transaction_is_not_found():\n    with db_session() as db:\n        with pytest.raises(NotFound) as info:\n            check_no_negative(db, [Edit(919999999, 100)])\n        assert info.value.exit_code == 4\n        with pytest.raises(NotFound):\n            check_no_negative(db, [Delete(919999999)])\n\n\ndef test_combined_changes_judged_by_net_effect_in_either_order():\n    with db_session() as db:\n        _seed(db, \"ZZBRG\", [700], 910000051)\n        credit, debit = Insert(\"ZZBRG\", 500), Insert(\"ZZBRG\", -1100)\n        assert check_no_negative(db, [credit, debit]) is None\n        assert check_no_negative(db, [debit, credit]) is None\n\n\ndef test_combined_changes_netting_below_zero_are_rejected():\n    with db_session() as db:\n        _seed(db, \"ZZBRH\", [700], 910000061)\n        with pytest.raises(Rejected):\n            check_no_negative(db, [Insert(\"ZZBRH\", 500), Insert(\"ZZBRH\", -1300)])\n\n\ndef test_one_overdrawn_account_rejects_whole_set_and_writes_nothing():\n    with db_session() as db:\n        _seed(db, \"ZZBRI\", [900], 910000071)\n        db.accounts.create(account=\"ZZBRJ\", name=\"Poor Test\")\n        db.transactions.create(txn_id=910000072, date=\"2026-05-01\", account=\"ZZBRJ\",\n                               category=CATEGORY, amount=100, memo=\"\")\n        before = _count(db, \"ZZBRI\", \"ZZBRJ\")\n        with pytest.raises(Rejected):\n            check_no_negative(db, [Insert(\"ZZBRI\", -900), Insert(\"ZZBRJ\", -101)])\n        assert _count(db, \"ZZBRI\", \"ZZBRJ\") == before\n\n\ndef test_untouched_account_does_not_affect_result():\n    with db_session() as db:\n        _seed(db, \"ZZBRK\", [100], 910000081)\n        db.accounts.create(account=\"ZZBRL\", name=\"Other Test\")\n        db.transactions.create(txn_id=910000082, date=\"2026-05-01\", account=\"ZZBRL\",\n                               category=CATEGORY, amount=-500, memo=\"\")\n        assert check_no_negative(db, [Insert(\"ZZBRK\", 0 + 1)]) is None\n"},"caller":{"type":"direct"}}],"container":null,"stop_reason":null,"stop_sequence":null,"stop_details":null,"usage":{"input_tokens":2,"cache_creation_input_tokens":959,"cache_read_input_tokens":45849,"cache_creation":{"ephemeral_5m_input_tokens":0,"ephemeral_1h_input_tokens":959},"output_tokens":8,"service_tier":"standard","inference_geo":"global","speed":"standard"},"input_transformations":[],"diagnostics":null,"context_management":null},"parent_tool_use_id":null,"session_id":"6e31620d-a49d-4cfb-89b1-216573851304","uuid":"e588c671-e7ce-4ff0-89a9-e77f8062060e","timestamp":"2026-10-27T14:27:34.143Z","request_id":"req_011CgSu4EtknMVkhRRu32dvG","wire_tool_inputs":{"toolu_01QuBYH3kK2MuWagBq6zzNPa":{"file_path":"/mnt/c/Users/barlo/projects/drydock/uat/LayersTesting/runs/20261027.135355/build/LayersTesting/tests/test_balances.py","content":"\"\"\"Balance import db_session\n\nCATEGORY = \"ZZBRCAT\"\n\n\ndef _seed(db, account, amounts, first_txn_id):\n    db.accounts.create(account=account, name=\"Balance Test\")\n    db.categories.create(category=CATEGORY, description=\"Balance Cat\")\n    for offset, cents in enumerate(amounts):\n        db.transactions.create(txn_id=first_txn_id + offset, date=\"2026-05-01\", account=account,\n                               category=CATEGORY, amount=cents, memo=\"\")\n\n\ndef _count(db, *accounts):\n    return sum(len(db.transactions.list(account=account)) for account in accounts)\n\n\ndef test_current_balance_sums_stored_amounts():\n    with db_session() as db:\n        _seed(db, \"ZZBRA\", [1000, -300, -50], 910000001)\n        assert current_balance(db, \"ZZBRA\") == 650\n\n\ndef test_current_balance_is_zero_for_account_without_transactions():\n    with db_session() as db:\n        db.accounts.create(account=\"ZZBRE\", name=\"Empty Test\")\n        assert current_balance(db, \"ZZBRE\") == 0\n\n\ndef test_insert_landing_on_zero_is_allowed():\n    with db_session() as db:\n        _seed(db, \"ZZBRB\", [700], 910000011)\n        assert check_no_negative(db, [Insert(\"ZZBRB\", -700)]) is None\n\n\ndef test_insert_one_cent_below_zero_is_rejected_and_writes_nothing():\n    with db_session() as db:\n        _seed(db, \"ZZBRC\", [700], 910000021)\n        before = _count(db, \"ZZBRC\")\n        with pytest.raises(Rejected) as info:\n            check_no_negative(db, [Insert(\"ZZBRC\", -701)])\n        assert info.value.exit_code == 3\n        assert _count(db, \"ZZBRC\") == before\n\n\ndef test_insert_into_new_account_accepts_positive_and_rejects_negative():\n    with db_session() as db:\n
